full_judgment: 2. Defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations of the plaint and contended inter alia that by a registered deed of gift dated 30.4.1928 Meljan Bibi had transferred her entire interest in the suit jote to her brother Asad Ali and thereby she divested herself of all interests in the suit property and as such the plaintiff did not acquire any interest in (he suit land. It was further contended that the SA Khatian and RS Khatian have been rightly prepared in the names of the defendants. The plaintiff has no title and possession in the suit property and as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
